source_refs.note: Roman Urdu: practice mcqs written from Chapter 24 (PDF 215-227), not printed in the book; same questions and order as the English set. Drafts needing academic review.

blocks.text: Yeh chapter 24 (Evolution) ke poore chapter se practice MCQs hain, chapter ke sections ki tarteeb mein. Har sawal ka aik sahi jawab hai aur saath mukhtasar wajah; numerical sawalon mein hal ke qadam diye gaye hain.

blocks.prompt:
1 Evolution is the gradual change, over successive generations, in a population's:
(Evolution kai naslon mein population ki kis cheez mein batadreej tabdeeli hai?)
blocks.explanation: Section 24.1: evolution population ki genetic banawat (allele frequencies) mein batadreej tabdeeli hai jo nayi species bana sakti hai.

book_ref.quote: Evolution is the gradual change in the genetic makeup (allele frequencies) of a population

blocks.prompt:
2 Which was one of the earliest speculations of the concept of evolution?
(Evolution ke tasawwur ke ibtidai qiyasaat mein se aik kaun sa tha?)

options.text: Aaj ke jandar aik dam paida nahi kiye gaye
Jandar hamesha maujooda shakal mein the
Jandar be-jaan maadde se bante hain
Har jandar alag alag banaya gaya

blocks.explanation: Section 24.1: qiyasaat yeh the ke jandar hamesha maujooda shakal mein nahi the, aik dam paida nahi hue, aur adna se aala shakal tak be-shumar tabdeeliyon ka nateeja hain.

book_ref.quote: They are the result of innumerable changes from the lower to the higher form

blocks.prompt:
3 Natural selection results in:
(Natural selection ka nateeja kya hota hai?)

options.text: behtar khususiyaat wale afraad ke feesad mein izafa

blocks.explanation: Section 24.1: faidamand khususiyaat wale agli naslen paida karte hain, is liye behtar khususiyaat walon ka feesad barhta hai.

book_ref.quote: It results in the increase in the percentage of individuals with better traits in populations

blocks.prompt:
4 The 'theory of intelligent design' is another name for:
('Theory of intelligent design' kis ka doosra naam hai?)
blocks.explanation: Section 24.1: creationism kehta hai ke tamam jandar isi tarah banaye gaye jaise aaj hain, har aik alag, baghair tabdeeli.

book_ref.quote: According to the theory of Creationism (“theory of intelligent design”)

blocks.prompt:
5 The early belief that living creatures can develop from non-living matter is called:
(Yeh qadeem aqeeda ke jandar be-jaan maadde se ban sakte hain:)
blocks.explanation: Section 24.1: tajrubaat ne spontaneous generation ko ghalat sabit kiya magar creationism ko radd nahi kar sake.

book_ref.quote: It was called idea of spontaneous generation

blocks.prompt:
6 Darwin travelled as a naturalist on HMS Beagle in:
(Darwin HMS Beagle par naturalist ke taur par kab rawana hue?)
blocks.explanation: Section 24.2: 1831 mein HMS Beagle par duniya ke gird 5 saal ka safar kiya.

book_ref.quote: In 1831, he travelled as a naturalist on scientific expedition

blocks.prompt:
7 The voyage of HMS Beagle around the world lasted:
(HMS Beagle ka duniya ke gird safar kitne arse ka tha?)
blocks.explanation: Section 24.2: Darwin ne duniya ke gird 5 saal ka safar kiya.

book_ref.quote: He made a 5-year voyage around the world

blocks.prompt:
8 Darwin's discovery of fossils of gigantic extinct mammals suggested that:
(Bare naapaid mammals ke fossils ki daryaft ne kya zahir kiya?)

options.text: zindagi be-jaan maadde se aati hai
acquired characters wirasat mein jate hain
jandar waqt ke saath badalte hain

blocks.explanation: Section 24.2: maazi mein jandar bohat mukhtalif the, yani jandar waqt ke saath badalte hain.

book_ref.quote: He dug up fossils of gigantic extinct mammals

blocks.prompt:
9 On the Galápagos Islands Darwin saw that giant tortoises of different islands differed in:
(Galápagos par Darwin ne dekha ke mukhtalif jazeeron ke bare kachhwe kis cheez mein mukhtalif the?)

options.text: khol ki shakal (zeen jaisi ya gumbad jaisi)

blocks.explanation: Section 24.2: aik jazeere ke kachhwon ke khol zeen jaise aur doosre ke gumbad jaise the.

book_ref.quote: the giant tortoises on one island had saddle-shaped shells

blocks.prompt:
10 Many Galápagos plants and animals resembled most closely those of:
(Galápagos ke bohat se paude aur janwar sab se zyada kis se milte the?)
blocks.explanation: Section 24.2: bohat se South America ke paudon aur janwaron se zyada milte the.

book_ref.quote: many plants and animals resembled more with the plants and animals of South America

blocks.prompt:
11 The different sizes and shapes of beaks of Galápagos finches were:
(Galápagos finches ki chonchon ke mukhtalif size aur shakalen kya theen?)
blocks.explanation: Section 24.2: chonch ke farq mukhtalif jazeeron par mukhtalif khurak khane ki mutabiqat (adaptations) the.

book_ref.quote: differences in the sizes and shapes of beaks were actually adaptations for feeding

blocks.prompt:
12 Darwin thought a new species would arise from an ancestral form by:
(Darwin ke khayal mein nayi species aabai shakal se kaise banti?)

options.text: naye mahol ki adaptations ka batadreej jama hona

blocks.explanation: Section 24.2: asal habitat se alag naye mahol ke mutabiq adaptations ke batadreej jama hone se.

book_ref.quote: A new species would arise from an ancestral form by the gradual accumulation of adaptations

blocks.prompt:
13 Darwin published 'On the Origin of Species' in:
(Darwin ne 'On the Origin of Species' kab shaya ki?)
blocks.explanation: Section 24.2.1: Darwin (1809-1882) ne yeh kitab 1859 mein shaya ki.

book_ref.quote: In 1859, he published his book “On the Origin of Species”

blocks.prompt:
14 Darwin's point of overproduction is illustrated in the book by a female sea star that releases each season about:
(Overproduction ki misaal mein maada sea star har mausam mein taqreeban kitne ande deti hai?)
blocks.explanation: Section 24.2.1: maada sea star har mausam taqreeban 10 lakh ande deti hai; jandaron ki tolidi salahiyat haqiqat se kahin zyada hai.

book_ref.quote: a female sea star releases about 1 million eggs each season

blocks.prompt:
15 Which statement about variations in Darwin's theory is correct?
(Darwin ke nazariye mein variations ke bare mein kaun sa bayan durust hai?)

options.text: Do afraad aam taur par bilkul aik jaise hote hain
Wirasati variations aulad mein ja sakti hain
Variations jandar ki khwahish se banti hain

blocks.explanation: Section 24.2.1: do afraad kam hi bilkul aik jaise hote hain; variations faidamand, nuqsan deh ya neutral; wirasati variations aulad mein jati hain.

book_ref.quote: Inherited variations can be passed on to offspring

blocks.prompt:
16 A neutral variation is one that is:
(Neutral variation kaisi hoti hai?)
blocks.explanation: Section 24.2.1: neutral variation na faidamand na nuqsan deh hoti hai.

book_ref.quote: neutral (neither helpful nor harmful)

blocks.prompt:
17 Variations that keep individuals successful in reproduction during the struggle for survival are called:
(Bacha ki jang mein afraad ko tolid mein kamyab rakhne wali variations kehlati hain:)
blocks.explanation: Section 24.2.1: faidamand variations wale tolid mein kamyab rehte hain; yeh adaptive traits hain.

book_ref.quote: Such variations are called adaptive traits

blocks.prompt:
18 Disadvantageous traits in a population, over generations:
(Nuqsan deh khususiyaat naslon ke saath:)

options.text: kam ho kar aakhir khatam ho jati hain

blocks.explanation: Section 24.2.1: nuqsan deh khususiyaat wale kam tolid karte hain, is liye yeh kam ho kar aakhir khatam ho jati hain.

book_ref.quote: such traits become less frequent in a population and eventually are eliminated

blocks.prompt:
19 Darwin's and Wallace's theories were presented together to the Linnean Society in:
(Darwin aur Wallace ke nazariye Linnean Society mein ikatthe kab pesh hue?)
blocks.explanation: Section 24.2.1: dono nazariye 1858 mein pesh hue; Wallace ka khat bhi 1858 ka tha (chhapa hua 1957 ghalat hai).

book_ref.quote: When both Darwin’s and Wallace’s theories were presented to the Linnaean Society in 1858

blocks.prompt:
20 Neo-Darwinism was developed by integrating Darwinism with:
(Neo-Darwinism Darwinism ko kis ke saath mila kar bana?)
blocks.explanation: Section 24.2.2: beesvin sadi ke shuru mein Darwinism ko modern genetics se milaya gaya.

book_ref.quote: the Darwinism was integrated with modern genetics to develop Neo-Darwinism

blocks.prompt:
21 Neo-Darwinism is based on the:
(Neo-Darwinism kis par mabni hai?)
blocks.explanation: Section 24.2.2: Neo-Darwinism Hardy-Weinberg theorem par mabni hai aur evolution ko allele frequency ki tabdeeli kehta hai.

book_ref.quote: Neo-Darwinism is based on Hardy-Weinberg Theorem

blocks.prompt:
22 The Hardy-Weinberg theorem was presented in 1908 by Godfrey Hardy, an English mathematician, and Wilhelm Weinberg, a German:
(Hardy-Weinberg theorem 1908 mein Godfrey Hardy (English mathematician) aur Wilhelm Weinberg ne pesh kiya, jo German:)
blocks.explanation: Section 24.2.2: Wilhelm Weinberg German physician (doctor) the.

book_ref.quote: In 1908, English mathematician Godfrey Hardy and German physician Wilhelm Weinberg

blocks.prompt:
23 According to the Hardy-Weinberg theorem, in a large randomly mating population with no evolutionary forces, allele and genotype frequencies:
(Hardy-Weinberg ke mutabiq bari, be-tarteeb mating wali population mein allele aur genotype frequencies:)

options.text: nasl dar nasl yaksan rehti hain

blocks.explanation: Section 24.2.2: agar koi evolutionary quwwat amal na kare to yeh nasl dar nasl yaksan rehti hain.

book_ref.quote: remain constant from generation to generation, if no evolutionary forces are acting

blocks.prompt:
24 Random mating, a Hardy-Weinberg condition, means that:
(Random mating ka matlab hai:)

options.text: har fard ko har doosre se mating ka barabar mauqa

blocks.explanation: Section 24.2.2: har fard ko kisi bhi doosre fard se mating ka barabar mauqa ho.

book_ref.quote: Every individual must have an equal chance of mating with any other individual

blocks.prompt:
25 If 600 out of 1000 genes for flower colour in a population are for red colour, the allele frequency of red is:
(Agar population mein phool ke rang ke 1000 genes mein se 600 laal rang ke hon to laal ki allele frequency:)
blocks.explanation: Section 24.2.2: allele frequency = 600 ÷ 1000 = 0.6 (60%).

book_ref.quote: Gene pool means the total number of all genes for a trait in a population

blocks.prompt:
26 The number or proportion of individuals with a particular genotype in a population is the:
(Population mein kisi khaas genotype wale afraad ki tadaad ya nisbat:)
blocks.explanation: Section 24.2.2: maslan 100 mein se 40 RR paude, genotype frequency 0.4.

book_ref.quote: Genotype frequency is the number or proportion of individuals with a particular genotype

blocks.prompt:
27 Genetic drift is often called:
(Genetic drift ko aksar kya kaha jata hai?)
blocks.explanation: Section 24.2.2: genetic drift, jo fitness nahi balke ittefaq se hota hai, ko aksar neutral selection kehte hain.

book_ref.quote: Genetic drift is often called neutral selection

blocks.prompt:
28 Genetic drift is most obvious in:
(Genetic drift sab se wazeh kahan hota hai?)
blocks.explanation: Section 24.2.2: ittefaqi tabdeeliyan chhoti populations mein sab se wazeh hoti hain.

book_ref.quote: are most obvious in small populations

blocks.prompt:
29 A rabbit population reduced from 100 to 10 by a fire, whose survivors happen by chance to be mostly brown, will have:
(Aag se 100 se 10 reh jane wali khargosh population, jis ke bache hue ittefaq se zyada tar bhoore hon, mein:)

options.text: allele frequency mein koi tabdeeli nahi

blocks.explanation: Section 24.2.2: bachna ittefaq tha, mutabiqat nahi; genetic tanawwo kam ho jata hai.

book_ref.quote: The resulting population will have lower genetic diversity

blocks.prompt:
30 The origin of all new genes is:
(Tamam naye genes ka asal mamba kya hai?)
blocks.explanation: Section 24.2.2: mutations tamam naye genes ka asal aur variations ka mamba hain.

book_ref.quote: Mutations, however, are a fact of life

blocks.prompt:
31 Mutational equilibrium exists when:
(Mutational equilibrium kab hota hai?)

options.text: wild type se mutant aur mutant se wild type mutation barabar hon

blocks.explanation: Section 24.2.2: aage aur wapas mutation barabar hon to asar baghair mutation jaisa; yeh kam hi hota hai.

book_ref.quote: This has the same effect on allelic frequency as if no mutation occurred

blocks.prompt:
32 A measure of the tendency for gene frequencies to change through mutation is:
(Mutation se gene frequencies ke badalne ke rujhan ka paimana:)
blocks.explanation: Section 24.2.2: yeh mutation pressure hai.

book_ref.quote: Mutation pressure is a measure of the tendency for gene frequencies to change through mutation

blocks.prompt:
33 According to the book, most mutations are:
(Kitab ke mutabiq zyada tar mutations kaisi hoti hain?)
blocks.explanation: Section 24.2.2: zyada tar mutations nuqsan deh hoti hain; kuch aik mahol mein neutral ya nuqsan deh aur doosre mein madadgar.

book_ref.quote: Most are deleterious. Some may be neutral or harmful in one environment

blocks.prompt:
34 The study of the geographic distribution of plants and animals is:
(Paudon aur janwaron ki geographic taqseem ka mutalia:)
blocks.explanation: Section 24.3.1: biogeography batati hai ke duniya ke mukhtalif hisson ki zindagi ki alag evolutionary tareekh hai.

book_ref.quote: Biogeography (study of the geographic distribution of plants and animals)

blocks.prompt:
35 The major herbivores of Australia and Tasmania, cited as biogeographic evidence, are:
(Australia aur Tasmania ke bare herbivores jo biogeography ka saboot hain:)
blocks.explanation: Section 24.3.1: rukawaton se alag jandar milte julte mahol mein bhi mukhtalif hote hain, maslan Australia ke kangaroo.

book_ref.quote: Many species of kangaroos are the major herbivores of Australia and Tasmania

blocks.prompt:
36 Islands often have relatively few but unique species because of:
(Jazeeron par aksar kam magar munfarid species kyun hoti hain?)

options.text: jazeere par aabadkari aur baad ke evolutionary waqiat
organs ka istemal aur adam istemal

blocks.explanation: Section 24.3.1: jazeere par aabadkari aur us ke baad ke evolutionary waqiat ki wajah se.

book_ref.quote: Islands often have relatively few but unique species

blocks.prompt:
37 Body parts similar in structure but different in function are:
(Banawat mein milte julte magar kaam mein mukhtalif jism ke hisse:)
blocks.explanation: Section 24.3.2: yeh homologous structures hain; is ko homology kehte hain.

book_ref.quote: Body parts that are similar in structure but different in function are called homologous structures

blocks.prompt:
38 Homologous structures reveal:
(Homologous structures kis ki nishandahi karti hain?)
blocks.explanation: Section 24.3.2: homologous structures wale jandaron ka mushtarka jadd hai aur yeh mukhtalif qismon mein bane.

book_ref.quote: Homologous structures reveal divergent evolution

blocks.prompt:
39 The wing of a bird and the wing of an insect are:
(Parinde ka par aur keere ka par:)
blocks.explanation: Section 24.3.2: dono urne ki mutabiqat hain magar homologous nahi; yeh analogous organs hain jo convergent evolution dikhate hain.

book_ref.quote: The organs which are similar in function but differ in structure are called analogous organs

blocks.prompt:
40 The similarities between the wings of birds and insects simply reflect that, to fly, an animal must have:
(Parinde aur keere ke paron ki mushabihat sirf yeh batati hai ke urne ke liye janwar ke paas hona chahiye:)

options.text: chauri, chapti glide karne wali satah

blocks.explanation: Section 24.3.2: urne ke liye chauri, chapti glide karne wali satah zaroori hai.

book_ref.quote: to fly, an animal must have a broad, flat gliding surface

blocks.prompt:
41 Minute remnants of hindlimb (pelvic) bones in pythons and boa constrictors are examples of:
(Python aur boa constrictor mein pichhli tangon (pelvic) ki haddiyon ki baqiyat kis ki misaal hai?)
blocks.explanation: Section 24.3.2: yeh reptile aabao ke aazaa ki baqiyat hain, evolution ka wazeh saboot.

book_ref.quote: some snakes like boa constrictors and pythons have minute remnants of hindlimb (pelvic) bones

blocks.prompt:
42 About how many vestigial structures are present in the human body, according to the book?
(Kitab ke mutabiq insani jism mein taqreeban kitni vestigial structures hain?)
blocks.explanation: Section 24.3.2: taqreeban 90, maslan appendix, coccyx, wisdom teeth aur kaan ke muscles.

book_ref.quote: There are about 90 vestigial structures present in human body

blocks.prompt:
43 In humans, the vermiform appendix is a vestige of the:
(Insan mein vermiform appendix kis ki baqiyat hai?)
blocks.explanation: Section 24.3.2: appendix cecum ki baqiyat hai; coccyx dum ki baqiyat hai.

book_ref.quote: Vermiform appendix is a vestige of the cecum

blocks.prompt:
44 The wisdom teeth are vestigial third molars that human ancestors used for:
(Wisdom teeth vestigial teesri daarhen hain jo insani aabao kis kaam mein late the?)
blocks.explanation: Section 24.3.2: aabao inhein paudon ke tissue peesne mein istemal karte the.

book_ref.quote: The wisdom teeth are vestigial third molars

blocks.prompt:
45 Molecular biology shows that, just as animals can have homologous structures, they may also have:
(Molecular biology batati hai ke homologous structures ki tarah janwaron mein ho sakte hain:)
blocks.explanation: Section 24.3.3: qareebi janwaron ka DNA aur proteins milte julte hain, yani homologous biochemicals.

book_ref.quote: they may also have homologous biochemicals

blocks.prompt:
46 Scientists estimate the time elapsed since evolution from a common ancestral molecule by comparing dissimilarities in DNA and proteins and assuming:
(Mushtarka aabai molecule se guzra waqt andaza lagane ke liye scientists DNA aur proteins ke farq ke saath kya farz karte hain?)
blocks.explanation: Section 24.3.3: proteins aur DNA ke farq dekh kar aur mutation ki taqreeban yaksan raftaar farz kar ke.

book_ref.quote: and by assuming relatively constant mutation rates

blocks.prompt:
47 A gene for antibiotic resistance in bacteria, according to the book, evolved by:
(Kitab ke mutabiq bacteria mein antibiotic resistance ka gene kaise bana?)
blocks.explanation: Section 24.3.3: resistance bacterial genes ki mutations se ho sakti hai; yeh gene natural selection se bana aur agli naslon mein jata hai.

book_ref.quote: Antibiotic resistance means that bacteria are able to survive under the exposure of an antibiotic

blocks.prompt:
48 The earliest organisms on Earth, the prokaryotes, originated about:
(Zameen ke pehle jandar, prokaryotes, taqreeban kab paida hue?)
blocks.explanation: Section 24.4: prokaryotes taqreeban 3.5 arab saal pehle; eukaryotes taqreeban 2 arab saal pehle.

book_ref.quote: originated in a very unstable environment from the reactions of organic molecules about 3.5 billion years ago

blocks.prompt:
49 Eukaryotes evolved from prokaryotes about:
(Eukaryotes prokaryotes se taqreeban kab bane?)
blocks.explanation: Section 24.4: taqreeban 2 arab saal pehle.

book_ref.quote: About 2 billion years ago, eukaryotes evolved from prokaryotes

blocks.prompt:
50 The Endosymbiotic Theory was proposed by:
(Endosymbiotic Theory kis ne pesh ki?)
blocks.explanation: Section 24.4: Lynn Margulis ne Endosymbiotic Theory pesh ki.

book_ref.quote: This theory was proposed by Lynn Margulis

blocks.prompt:
51 According to the Endosymbiotic Theory, small engulfed prokaryotes able to do aerobic respiration became:
(Endosymbiotic Theory ke mutabiq aerobic respiration karne wale chhote prokaryotes kya bane?)
blocks.explanation: Section 24.4: aerobic chhote prokaryotes bare cell ko energy dete aur mitochondria ban gaye.

book_ref.quote: Some of the small prokaryotes were able to do aerobic respiration

blocks.prompt:
52 Engulfed small cells that used sunlight to make food and shared it with the large cell became:
(Dhoop se khurak bana kar bare cell ko dene wale chhote cells kya bane?)
blocks.explanation: Section 24.4: yeh eukaryotic cells ke chloroplasts ban gaye.

book_ref.quote: Other small cells were able to use sunlight to make food

blocks.prompt:
53 Flagella of eukaryotes may have derived through the ingestion of prokaryotes similar to:
(Eukaryotes ke flagella kin jaise prokaryotes ko nigalne se bane honge?)
blocks.explanation: Section 24.4: flagella spirochetes jaise prokaryotes nigalne se bane honge.

book_ref.quote: flagella may have derived through the ingestion of prokaryotes similar to spirochetes

blocks.prompt:
54 The DNA of mitochondria and chloroplasts is organized as:
(Mitochondria aur chloroplasts ka DNA kis shakal mein hota hai?)
blocks.explanation: Section 24.4: in ka apna DNA prokaryotes ki tarah circular chromosome mein hota hai.

book_ref.quote: Their DNA is organized in a circular chromosome like a prokaryotic chromosome

blocks.prompt:
55 Mitochondria and chloroplasts reproduce by:
(Mitochondria aur chloroplasts kaise taqseem hote hain?)
blocks.explanation: Section 24.4: yeh prokaryotes ki tarah binary fission se, jab ke eukaryotic cells mitosis se taqseem hote hain.

book_ref.quote: Mitochondria (and chloroplasts) can reproduce by binary fission like prokaryotes

blocks.prompt:
56 According to the Membrane Invagination Theory, the nucleus and endoplasmic reticulum formed by:
(Membrane Invagination Theory ke mutabiq nucleus aur endoplasmic reticulum kaise bane?)

options.text: prokaryotic cell membrane ka cytoplasm mein andar murna

blocks.explanation: Section 24.4: cell membrane andar ko mur kar nucleus aur ER bani aur eukaryotic cell bana.

book_ref.quote: the cell membrane of prokaryotic cell invaginated in the cytoplasm

blocks.prompt:
57 The power and efficiency of eukaryotic cells evolved by endosymbiosis enabled them to evolve:
(Endosymbiosis se bane eukaryotic cells ki taqat aur efficiency ne kya mumkin banaya?)

options.text: multicellularity, cell specialization aur bara size

blocks.explanation: Section 24.4: multicellularity, cell specialization aur bara size, jo janwaron, paudon aur fungi ke tanawwo ki kunji hain.

book_ref.quote: Their power and efficiency enabled them to evolve new characteristics

blocks.prompt:
58 Jean-Baptiste Lamarck was a:
(Jean-Baptiste Lamarck kaun the?)
blocks.explanation: Section 24.5: Lamarck (1744-1829) French naturalist aur evolution ke ibtidai haami the.

book_ref.quote: The French naturalist Jean-Baptiste Lamarck (1744 - 1829)

blocks.prompt:
59 Lamarck presented his idea of progression in the book 'Philosophie Zoologique' (Zoological Philosophy), published in:
(Lamarck ki kitab 'Philosophie Zoologique' kab shaya hui?)
blocks.explanation: Section 24.5: 1809 mein shaya hui.

book_ref.quote: In 1809, he published a book

blocks.prompt:
60 According to Lamarckism, organisms changed:
(Lamarckism ke mutabiq jandar kaise badle?)
blocks.explanation: Section 24.5: jandar mahol ke mutabiq hote hue saada se pecheeda bane.

book_ref.quote: According to Lamarckism, organisms changed from simplest to complex

blocks.prompt:
61 Lamarck called changes in body parts caused by long-term use or disuse:
(Lamarck ne lambe istemal ya adam istemal se jism mein tabdeeliyon ko kya naam diya?)
blocks.explanation: Section 24.5: unhon ne inhein 'acquired characters' kaha.

book_ref.quote: He named such changes in body parts, which occur due to long term use or disuse

blocks.prompt:
62 According to Lamarck's idea of use and disuse, organs that are used more frequently:
(Lamarck ke mutabiq zyada istemal hone wale organs:)

options.text: taraqqi kar ke mazboot hote hain

blocks.explanation: Section 24.5: zyada istemal wale organs taqatwar hote, kam istemal wale kamzor hote hain.

book_ref.quote: the organs which are used more frequently are developed and become strong

blocks.prompt:
63 According to Lamarck's giraffe example, the short-necked ancestors of giraffe used to eat:
(Lamarck ki giraffe misaal mein chhoti gardan wale aabao kya khate the?)

options.text: ghaas ya chhote paudon ke patte

blocks.explanation: Section 24.5: yeh ghaas ya chhote paudon ke patte khate the; jab yeh na rahe to oonche darakhton ke liye gardan khenchi.

book_ref.quote: They used to eat grass or the leaves of small plants

blocks.prompt:
64 In Lamarck's explanation, the longer neck gained by stretching during a giraffe's lifetime was:
(Lamarck ke mutabiq zindagi mein gardan khenchne se lambi gardan kya thi?)
blocks.explanation: Section 24.5: zindagi mein hasil lambi gardan acquired character thi jise wirasati kaha gaya.

book_ref.quote: their necks became strong and long during their lifetime

blocks.prompt:
65 Lamarckism was disproved mainly because acquired characters:
(Lamarckism ghalat kyun sabit hua?)

options.text: in ki genetic bunyad nahi aur wirasat mein nahi jate

blocks.explanation: Section 24.5.1: acquired characters ki koi genetic bunyad nahi, is liye wirasat mein nahi jate; organs khwahish ya zaroorat se nahi badalte.

book_ref.quote: The acquired characters have no genetic basis
